notes: This portable scenario calls the official named joinFederationExecution overload twice through the same connected RTIambassador. The first call joins; the second must throw FederateAlreadyExecutionMember. A successful resignation afterward confirms the original membership remains active. It uses only the official IEEE 1516.1-2025 C++ API and standard library and reuses the corresponding condition in java-tck.federation-membership.
